name: unknown_day_change_renders_as_words_20261105
comment: ANCHOR: UNKNOWN_DAY_CHANGE_RENDERS_AS_WORDS_20261105 — an unmeasured day change is the word unknown, never 0 and never a crash.
2026-11-05 (codex-cloud P2 on PR #2588): a None day change from the Fidelity fund lane broke
llm_context_engine.get_portfolio_context(), and the same class of defect existed wherever a
producer seeded 0.0, or a consumer coerced None with 'or 0' or formatted it directly.
scripts/lib/day_change_display.py is now the single strict renderer; a genuine measured 0.00
still renders as zero, and every consumer renders unknown as a word.
